definitions.explanation: Medicine prepared as a fine powder rather than as tablets or liquid. Typically dispensed in small paper packets and taken with water. Common in Japan for both prescription and over-the-counter remedies, especially cold medicines and stomach treatments.

examples.japanese: {粉薬|こなぐすり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦|にが}い→苦い：01201_nigai⟧。
{粉薬|こなぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I took the powdered medicine with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粉薬|こなぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嫌|いや}がる→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ゼリー→ゼリー：11025_zerii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{飲|の}ませている→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: Our child hates powdered medicine, so we mix it into jelly to get him to take it.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧ (powder) + ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (medicine). The ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ voices to ぐすり through {連濁|れんだく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粉薬|こなぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take powdered medicine
- {粉薬|こなぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe a powder medication
- {粉薬|こなぐすり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: bad at taking powdered medicine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{錠剤|じょうざい}→錠剤：17290_jouzai⟧: tablet; pill — solid medicine in a pressed form
- ⟦カプセル→カプセル：22926_kapuseru⟧: capsule — powder or liquid medicine inside a soluble shell
- {水薬|すいやく}/{液剤|えきざい}: liquid medicine
